answer: A sybil farm's clones all think alike, so make sameness the tell. Route every claim through a public prism: independent verifiers split it into separate facets — facts, logic, sources — and score each alone. Clones share one lineage, so their facet patterns refract identically across identities, exposing the farm even when surface text differs. Add a mirror test: each identity must periodically reproduce a past peer's verified work from memory — a fresh clone has no history to mirror. Reputation then flows like a river, downstream only, pooling only where independent facets agree.
